problem: An older AutoMeta cursor can reinterpret changed source metadata after the reviewed lane registered exactly those bytes, replacing independent approval or ignoring native parent evidence.
scope: Reuse only an already materialized native v2 FINAL_QA/REVIEW2 record; no approval or metadata value is created by the reuse branch.
requiredProof: current source raw SHA256 and Git blob and complete exam denominator
same current metadata row and exact UID/ordinal as the applied native receipt
same runtime record and ACTIVE runtime document
same current identity and body/content fingerprints
ACTIVE PT/TPL and exact curriculum/course/unit/subunit binding
unchanged student payload from the prior AutoMeta source
failureBehavior: Missing, stale, inactive, ambiguous or altered proof retains the existing AutoMeta behavior.

tests.provenance: Existing suite plus targeted positive/negative receipt fixtures; not a new mathematical QA result.

independentPeerReview.finding: Require ACTIVE on the runtime document, not only an identical runtime row.
independentPeerReview.disposition: Fixed and covered by a negative case.
